decision: Qualify TQP-30 and TQP-31 for the retained bounded adaptive LOD selector and native Windows regular/transition assembly matrix, without widening the claim to dynamic adaptive terrain or world-boundary policy.
alternatives: reuse the production streaming selector without a separately bounded structural contract
qualify transition assembly from one face or one LOD relationship
accept interface screenshots without exact native edge and ownership evidence
require every skinny triangle geometric normal to agree with interpolated SDF normals instead of enforcing the native connected-component winding contract
evidence: ten deterministic cold/warm hierarchy scenarios covering interior, faces, edges, vertical exterior viewers, far viewers, and signed million-chunk origins
six injected invalid-hierarchy controls proving overlap, hole, alignment, LOD-range, neighbor-delta, and split-record detection
658 direct WorldTransvoxelCellProbe chunk calls covering 18 coarse-to-four-fine face fixtures plus fully assembled fine neighbors for 12 edge masks, 8 corner masks, all faces, and empty/full controls
exact interface equality, transition ownership, material, finite-buffer, connected-component winding, and cold/warm signature evidence
focused lod3_positive_x repro and native finalizer source inspection distinguishing one retained local skinny-triangle normal disagreement from a component winding defect
qualified_scope: balanced finite-root octree selection over a 16 by 16 by 16 LOD0 chunk domain with maximum LOD 4
deterministic split, merge, hysteresis, teleport reset, complete vertical coverage, origin shift, and maximum neighbor delta one policies
native coarse-to-four-fine regular/transition interfaces for all six faces at LOD 1/0, 2/1, and 3/2
native transition ownership for all perpendicular edge masks, corner masks, the all-face mask, and empty/full boundaries
retained Windows debug performance distributions and exact signatures
unqualified_scope: finite-world caps, unloaded-neighbor behavior, catalog boundaries, and enclosure policy
arbitrary adaptive arrangements beyond the retained static selector and assembly matrices
dynamic LOD publication, rendering, edits, streaming, collision, navigation, and persistence
independent topology oracles and adversarial randomized corpora reserved for TQP-33 and TQP-34
production performance, other platforms, and other native build profiles
baseline_changes: program manifest and qualification state revision 21
winding evidence aligned with world-transvoxel connected-component orientation semantics while retaining local triangle disagreements as diagnostics
review: Automated structural, analytical, negative-control, native interface, ownership, integrity, material, determinism, performance, and minimized-repro evidence passed. TQP-30 is a selector contract and TQP-31 is static machine geometry evidence; neither milestone claims visual acceptance or a dynamic terrain runtime.
downstream_impact: TQP-32 becomes the next dependency-ordered milestone. Gate E remains closed and production, destruction promotion, and GPU authority remain frozen behind it. No world-transvoxel source or binary change was required.
